name: Norwid Fahrradbau

geo.note: Marker at Elmshorn, the nearest town.

summary: Small workshop near Elmshorn, north of Hamburg, that builds steel and stainless-steel frames by hand, including custom sizes, for road, gravel, touring, randonneur and mountain bikes. A lower-priced Lofoten line is welded to Norwid specifications by the Czech maker Fort.
uncertain: Official website and street address not yet confirmed. Founding year from a dealer directory.

sources.name: BIKE: Diese MTB-Rahmen werden in Europa gebaut
BIKE: Frames built in Europe list

name: Nicolai

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (house level).

summary: Aluminium mountain bike and e-bike manufacturer that mills, welds and coats its frames in-house at its factory in Mehle (Elze), Lower Saxony. Frames are welded to order, with a tailor-made frame option.
uncertain: Which models the tailor-made geometry programme covers, and at what cost, is not published in our sources.

name: Alutech Cycles

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (house level).

summary: Aluminium enduro, downhill and e-MTB maker near the Baltic coast that moved frame production back from Taiwan to Germany in 2021; frames are welded in-house in Ascheffel.
uncertain: Founding year not confirmed. Whether the listed price is for a frame or a complete bike is not confirmed. Some carbon rear triangles were reported as sourced from Asia (BIKE, 2023).

sources.name: BIKE: Alutech bikes now made in Germany
BIKE Project Europe: Alutech frame welding

name: ax-lightness

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (house level).

summary: Carbon composites manufacturer that makes lightweight road frames such as the Vial Evo, plus components, in its own plant in Duderstadt rather than sourcing from Asia. The company also builds bikes under its Benotti brand.
uncertain: The brand dates from 1999; the current company was re-formed in 2015 and moved to Duderstadt in 2018. Current frame prices not confirmed.

sources.name: Fair Wheel Bikes: ax-lightness brand page
bike-x: Vial Evo in three versions

name: Starcycles
priceNote: Bike fitting worth €99–199 included with every bike purchase
summary: Road and gravel bike shop in the Sprinkenhof in Hamburg's Altstadt, listed as a Colnago Premium Store and Pinarello Pro-Shop. A bike fitting is included with every bike purchase.
uncertain: Street address, founding year and Colnago/Pinarello store status come from a dealer directory, not the shop's own Impressum.

name: Picocycles

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (house level).

summary: High-performance bike shop and workshop in Kiel, serving the area since 2004. It offers custom builds on framesets such as the Colnago C68, V4RS and Y1RS and the Pinarello Dogma F, with repaints arranged through specialist partners.
uncertain: Postal code not confirmed. No in-house bike-fitting service confirmed.

name: Picocycles Hamburg

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (house level).

summary: Hamburg showroom of Picocycles, a high-performance shop from Kiel, partnering with Colnago, Pinarello, Specialized and Scott. It offers consultation through to high-end custom builds.
uncertain: Opening date not confirmed. Whether Specialized here includes S-Works models is not confirmed.

name: Storck Store Hamburg

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (house level).

summary: Storck's own flagship concept store in Hamburg's HafenCity, opened in July 2024. It offers consultation, individual builds via Storck's configurator, test rides and workshop service.
uncertain: Brand-owned store rather than a multi-brand dealer. Bike fitting is listed for Storck stores in general. Founded = store opening.

name: Cycles Steil
summary: One-person workshop in Hamburg-Altona that brazes made-to-measure steel frames and bikes, mainly randonneuses in the French tradition, plus porteurs with large front racks and road bikes. There are no stock models: geometry and tubing are worked out on an adjustable fit rig in the workshop, and each frame is painted by a specialist painter in the customer's chosen colour. Visits by appointment.
uncertain: Founding year and prices are not published. The site does not load over HTTPS (TLS error), only over HTTP.

sources.name: Cycles Steil – process (fit rig, design, paint)

name: Fahrradmanufaktur Gebrüder Höing (Piratecyclex)
priceNote: Unsere Preise beginnen bei 900€ für einen pulverbeschichteten Standartrahmen. Kompletträder beginnen bei 1300€. Ein Lastenrad bekommst du bereits ab 2500€.
summary: Small workshop in four former shipping containers at the Platzprojekt in Hannover-Linden. It brazes made-to-measure steel frames for single speeds, cargo bikes, cruisers, recumbents and other special builds, and repairs cracked, broken or bent steel frames.
uncertain: The website footer dates from 2019 and the frame-building course page still says 'coming soon' (planned from 2020), so courses are not listed as a service; current activity was not confirmed beyond the live site.

name: Suicycle Store
summary: Bike shop and workshop in St. Pauli with an in-house frame builder who has built frames professionally since 1982, including custom, track, tandem and cyclocross frames; frame commissions are booked by appointment. The shop also sells complete bikes, cargo bikes and parts.
uncertain: The frame-building page does not state current frame materials, prices or where the frames are built today. Founding year not published (a 2025 city guide says the shop has existed for over 20 years). Brand list taken from the online shop; Ridley's dealer locator lists the shop; Open dealer status not checked against Open's locator.

sources.name: SZENE Hamburg: Die besten Fahrradläden in Hamburg (2025)

name: Schoof & Jensen
summary: Cargo bike maker founded in 2021 that designs and builds the compact, modular Doubledekker in its Flensburg workshop, with or without e-assist. Frames are welded by hand from CrMo steel in small series. The workshop also welds steel gravel frames for the Kiel brand Dankward.
uncertain: Hand welding, CrMo steel and the Dankward frames are reported by a third-party magazine visit (Weites.Land, Aug 2026), not on the maker's own site, which states 'Designt & produziert in Norddeutschland'. Prices not checked.

sources.name: Schoof & Jensen – home (made in Flensburg, founded 2021)

name: Dankward Bikes
summary: Small Kiel brand for road and gravel bikes, each hand-painted, specced and built up in its Kiel workshop. Its steel Fango gravel frame uses Italian tubing that is laser-cut and welded by a partner in Schleswig-Holstein, with final brazing and thread-cutting done in Kiel. Fitting is offered through Bikefitting Kiel.
uncertain: Only the steel Fango is documented as made in Germany; the origin of the carbon framesets (e.g. Fulmar) is not stated, so carbon is not listed. Founding year not verified (company register entry appears recent).

sources.name: Dankward – home (built and painted in Kiel)
Weites.Land: Schoof & Jensen builds Dankward gravel frames

name: Trek Bicycle Hamburg Eppendorf
summary: Trek's own store in Eppendorf, described by Trek as its second store in Germany. It sells Trek, Diamant and Bontrager products, offers workshop service and promotes Trek's Project One custom programme (custom paint and component choice).
uncertain: Brand-owned store rather than an independent dealer. Fitting services are not described on the store page.

sources.name: Trek store finder – Project One retailers

name: Kingcycles
summary: Trek and Diamant dealer on Osterstraße in Eimsbüttel selling road, gravel, e-bikes and city bikes, with a workshop. It offers Trek's Project One custom-bike programme.
uncertain: Trek's store finder lists Kingcycles as a Trek retailer but not under the Project One filter; Project One offer is from the shop's own page.

name: Bikefactory Schanze
summary: Road, gravel and triathlon shop in the Schanzenviertel with a Colnago shop-in-shop, listed by Cervélo as a dealer and by Specialized as an S-Works store, and also selling Cannondale, Orbea and Aurum. Frame sizing is included when buying a bike; the shop states it does not do full biomechanical fitting.
uncertain: The bikefitting.com dealer locator lists Bikefactory's Osdorfer Landstr. 186 site (22549) for static fitting, but the shop's own sizing page says it offers no in-depth fitting; fitting system therefore not listed. Older pages also showed BMC. Colnago shop-in-shop shown on the shop's own site; the shop does not appear in Colnago's store locator.

name: Harrys Rad Station
summary: Family-run bike shop in Rahlstedt, in its second generation, selling Cervélo road, gravel and triathlon bikes and Santa Cruz mountain bikes alongside Stevens, with a workshop.

name: HP-Bikes
summary: Road and triathlon bike store in Rosengarten, south of Hamburg near the A7 Hittfeld exit. It sells Cervélo, Look and Focus, builds bikes to customer specification and also offers used, test and demo road bikes.

name: Veloskop
summary: Road, triathlon and gravel bike studio in Elmshorn, north-west of Hamburg, that combines bike sales with its own fitting process ('Veloskopie'), offered for over 20 years. Bikes from Factor, Ridley, Open, Time, Orbea and Kú Cycle are sold in combination with a fitting; Kú frames are made to measure after the fit.
uncertain: Visits are by appointment. The fitting is certified by the independent International Bike Fitting Institute (second-highest level, per the shop), not one of the named commercial systems. Ridley's dealer locator lists the shop; dealer status for Factor, Open and Time not confirmed by those brands' locators.

name: Radsport Cyclefactory
summary: Road and gravel specialist in Altona founded in 2001, with a second racing-focused 'Performance Zentrum' at Kollaustraße 4. Brands include Colnago, De Rosa, Wilier, Ridley, Bianchi and Basso; Axiom frames, hand-made in Italy, are also offered made to measure.
uncertain: The Kollaustraße 4 address is taken from the shop's homepage; the Performance site's Impressum page could not be read.

name: Pirate-Bikes
summary: Small road and mountain bike shop in the Neustadt, independent since 2003, run by a former pro-team mechanic. Its brand page lists Cervélo and Storck, plus its own Pirate-branded bikes and clothing.
uncertain: The brand page is undated and appears old (it also lists Felt); Cervélo's store locator lists the shop; current Storck dealer status not confirmed.

name: Das Radhaus
summary: Bike shop in Stade, west of Hamburg, covering road and gravel bikes as well as e-bikes, with a workshop. It is listed as a fitting location in the bikefitting.com dealer locator.
uncertain: Fitting is listed in the bikefitting.com locator as a static fit; the shop's own site mentions ergonomics advice but does not name the system.

sources.name: Kreiszeitung Wochenblatt – Radhaus Stade offers bikefitting

name: Oxbike
summary: Bike shop in Langenhorn, north Hamburg, selling road, gravel, time-trial, city and cargo bikes, recently appointed as a Trek dealer. As a Smartfit partner it uses Smartfit measurement to set frame size and riding position.

name: Radwelt Harsefeld
summary: Large bike and e-bike shop in Harsefeld near Buxtehude and Stade, listed in Cervélo's store locator.

name: Elbe Räderei
summary: Bike shop with showroom and workshop in Agathenburg, between Stade and Buxtehude, listed as a Ridley dealer.
uncertain: Brands other than Ridley could not be read from the shop's website (logos only).

name: PCT Shop Raible
summary: Small bike shop in Wörme, part of Handeloh south of Buchholz in der Nordheide, listed as a Ridley dealer.
uncertain: The shop's website returned 403, so address, website, range and services could not be verified on its own pages; entry rests on the Ridley locator only.

name: Riha Bikes
summary: Road, gravel and triathlon shop in Bremen's Neustadt carrying Specialized (including S-Works framesets), Colnago, BMC, Cervélo, Factor and Ridley. Listed by Colnago, Cervélo and Lightweight as a dealer; also offers repairs, upgrades and riding-position optimisation.
uncertain: Whether the position optimisation uses a certified fitting system is not stated.

sources.name: Riha Bikes – home page and brand menu

name: Trek Bicycle Bremen
summary: Trek-run store in Bremen-Findorff selling Trek road, gravel and mountain bikes plus Electra and Diamant. The store takes orders for Trek's Project One custom-paint programme and services bikes of all brands.

sources.name: Trek Bicycle Bremen – store page (Project One)

name: Radschlag Fahrradhandel
summary: Bike shop in Bremen's Viertel, trading for more than 40 years, with a separate fitting studio (Radschlag Bikefitting) offering road, gravel, triathlon and MTB fits with 3D video analysis and pressure mapping. Listed in the Bikefitting.com (Smartfit) dealer finder.
uncertain: The fitting studio's own site does not name the measuring system; the Bikefitting.com link rests on the finder listing.

name: havenBike
summary: Bremerhaven bike shop whose range includes Colnago, Cervélo and Wilier road bikes and Lightweight wheels alongside touring and e-bike brands. Offers Smartfit bike fitting and sizing with sit-bone measurement. Listed by Colnago and Lightweight as a dealer.
uncertain: Cervélo and Wilier are listed on the shop's brand page but the shop does not appear in the Cervélo locator.

name: Wiegetritt
summary: Road and gravel shop in Lilienthal on Bremen's north-eastern edge. Listed by Lightweight as a dealer; the bike range centres on Giant, Liv and Cadex, with Trek and Cannondale also in stock, and a workshop that services bikes bought elsewhere.
uncertain: The Lightweight list gives Hauptstraße 86, Lilienthal; the shop's own contact page and Impressum give Moorhauser Landstraße 33, used here.

name: Zweirad Bösche
summary: Shop in Kirchweyhe, south of Bremen, with a curated range that includes Look road bikes, idworx and Tout Terrain touring bikes and steel gravel frames from Manufaktur 83. Listed as a Cervélo dealer; Rohloff service partner.

name: Fahrradprofi Scheeßel
summary: Bike shop in Scheeßel (district of Rotenburg/Wümme) listed in Cervélo's German store locator as an authorised dealer.
uncertain: Only the Cervélo locator was found; no website, Impressum or further detail on range and services could be verified. The locator gives Große Str. 12, 27383 Scheeßel.

name: BikeOne Oldenburg
summary: Road, gravel and triathlon specialist in Oldenburg offering bike fitting by appointment and individually configured bikes (wheels, gearing, paint) through partner brands. Listed as a Cervélo dealer and Factor test centre; Pinarello and Trek bikes are sold in its shop.
uncertain: The fitting system used is not named.

sources.name: BikeOne – home page (fitting, custom configuration, brands)

name: BikeOne Osnabrück
summary: Osnabrück branch of the Oldenburg road and triathlon specialist BikeOne, with the same consultation, fitting and custom-configuration services and the Factor, Cervélo and Pinarello range.
uncertain: Brand locators list only the Oldenburg store; that the full range and fitting are offered in Osnabrück is inferred from the shared website.

name: Radel Bluschke
summary: Osnabrück shop founded in 1983 with a road-bike focus, selling Colnago (up to the V5Rs), Orbea, Trek and Cannondale, and listed by Colnago and Lightweight as a dealer. Smartfit bike sizing and fitting is offered as part of a new-bike consultation.
uncertain: The shop says Smartfit fitting is currently offered only with a new-bike purchase.

name: L&T Sporthaus Osnabrück with Fahrrad Pagels
summary: The L&T sports store in central Osnabrück sells Ridley bikes with the Ridley configurator. Since April 2026 the Hamburg shop Fahrrad Pagels runs the bike workshop, fitting (saddle-pressure and video analysis) and made-to-measure builds inside the store.
uncertain: Not in a Ridley locator; whether Ridley is sold by L&T or by Fahrrad Pagels is unclear. Fitting system not named. Address is Fahrrad Pagels' published location at L&T.

sources.name: L&T – bike fitting with Fahrrad Pagels

name: Zweirad Beilken
summary: Large shop in Oldenburg-Ofenerdiek that also runs a Cube store. Its brands include Ridley road and gravel bikes, and it is listed in the Bikefitting.com (Smartfit) dealer finder.
uncertain: The shop's own pages do not describe its fitting service; the Bikefitting.com link rests on the finder listing.

name: Buhl Bikes & Sports
summary: Oldenburg shop founded in 1994 for mountain, road and gravel bikes. Its brand list includes Santa Cruz alongside Orbea, Bianchi, Surly and Salsa, and it has its own workshop.
uncertain: Santa Cruz appears as a brand logo on the shop's site; not confirmed in a Santa Cruz locator.

sources.name: Buhl Bikes & Sports – home page and brands

name: Zweiradladen Aurich
summary: East Frisian shop trading for more than 40 years with a road range including Ridley, Look, Basso and Eddy Merckx plus Van Nicholas titanium and Define steel bikes. Offers Smartfit bike fitting with sit-bone measurement and builds ergonomically tailored bikes.

name: Zweirad Elferink
summary: Shop in Uelsen (Grafschaft Bentheim, near Nordhorn) listed as an authorised Cervélo dealer; its brand list also includes Scott, Giant and Cannondale alongside Dutch and e-bike brands.

name: Zweirad Nieberding
summary: Shop in Lohne (district of Vechta) with a road range that includes Factor, Pinarello and Cervélo alongside Orbea and Riese & Müller e-bikes. Listed by Factor as a retailer; the business has been run by the current owner family since 1997.
uncertain: Pinarello and Cervélo appear as brand logos on the shop's site; not confirmed in those brands' locators.

name: Biketime
summary: Multi-brand bike shop in Hannover with a road, gravel and MTB range that includes Cervélo, Pinarello, Wilier and Santa Cruz. Its in-house Fitting Center offers fittings on the customer's own bike or on a digital fitting bike, with a more extensive performance-oriented FITpro option.
uncertain: The fitting page does not name the fitting system used (it mentions a 'digital fitting bike'). Whether the shop is a Scott premium dealer is not stated.

name: Enjoyyourbike
summary: Online retailer with a showroom and workshop in Hannover-Linden, focused on road and gravel bikes. Brands include OPEN and TIME. The showroom offers bike fitting by appointment and is listed in the Retül fitter finder with a Level 1 fitter and the Retül 3D motion capture system and Müve fit bike.
uncertain: The street address is the company address in the Impressum; the site does not state separately that the showroom is at the same address (the Retül listing gives the same street). Authorised-dealer status for OPEN and TIME is inferred from the shop's own brand pages.

name: Velobunch
summary: Road and gravel bike shop with a workshop in Braunschweig's Atrium centre, run by Velocity Braunschweig GmbH. Listed in the Colnago store locator; the shop's own range also lists Factor and Cervélo.

name: Radkombinat
summary: Bike shop in Lüneburg's old town focused on road, gravel and cargo bikes. Its 'Dream Builds' service plans and assembles individual bikes with the customer; documented builds include Factor, TIME, Look and Ridley. Listed in the Colnago store locator.
uncertain: Factor and Ridley appear as completed custom builds; authorised-dealer status for those two brands is not stated explicitly on the shop's site.

name: Fahrradkontor Hannover
summary: Bike shop in Hannover-List selling city, trekking, road and gravel bikes. Listed in the Colnago store locator and presents itself as a Ridley and Simplon premium dealer. Offers bike fitting and ergonomics consultations with professional measurement.
uncertain: Fahrradkontor appears in bikefitting.com dealer data (static fit service) seen during research, but the finder page could not be loaded directly to confirm; the shop's own page does not name the fitting system.

sources.name: Fahrradkontor – sales, brands and bike fitting

name: Hackerott Bike Store
summary: Bike and e-bike store in Hannover-Hainholz operated by the Autopark Hackerott car dealership group. Its range includes a selection of LOOK road and gravel bikes.
uncertain: Authorised LOOK dealer status inferred from the shop's own brand list and offers; no LOOK locator entry checked.

sources.name: Hackerott Bike Store – home page (brands, LOOK models)

name: Fahrrad Schiwy
summary: Bike shop and certified master workshop in Burgdorf (Region Hannover). Brands shown include LOOK, Ridley and Scott. Services listed include body scanning, ergonomics advice, bike fitting and bikes built to customer specification.
uncertain: LOOK and Ridley appear as brand logos/links on the home page; authorised-dealer status and the fitting system used are not stated.

name: bunnyhop
summary: Large bike shop and online store in Hameln with a separate S-Works section, Santa Cruz and Cervélo in its range, a bike-fitting service and ORBEA MyO custom configurations.
uncertain: The fitting page does not name a system or describe the method. Cervélo appears via listed models rather than a brand page. Whether the shop is a Specialized S-Works/flagship dealer is inferred from its S-Works menu section.

name: Pedalritter
summary: Göttingen shop, in business for more than 20 years, that builds bikes to customer specification under its own Pedalritter brand, from size (optionally based on body measurement) to colour and components. Also sells Wilier, Basso and Tommasini road and gravel bikes.
uncertain: Brands are shown as logos only (Wilier, Basso, Tommasini, KTM, Böttcher, Intec, Campus); authorised Wilier dealer status not confirmed via a Wilier locator. Not a registered master workshop per its Impressum.

name: Atelier VELO Radsport
summary: Road-cycling shop in Braunschweig's university quarter, open since 1990, now trading with reduced hours (Thursday to Saturday) and concentrating on road, gravel, cyclocross, triathlon and MTB. Brands include Wilier, Bianchi and Basso.
uncertain: The owner states the shop continues in reduced form while a successor is sought. Bike fitting is announced as a future service. Wilier dealer status taken from the shop's own brand list.

name: Das Gifhorner Radhaus
summary: Bike and e-bike shop in central Gifhorn with its own workshop and Bosch service centre. Its brand list includes Ridley alongside Kalkhoff, Victoria and Conway.
uncertain: Range is mainly e-bikes and everyday bikes; which Ridley models are stocked is not stated.

name: E-Bike Kasten Brand Store Wolfsburg
summary: Large e-bike-focused store in Wolfsburg, part of the regional E-Bike Kasten group. The store page offers Trek Project One configuration appointments and bike-fitting appointments.
uncertain: The store does not appear in the Trek Project One retailer filter of the Trek store finder; Project One availability is taken from the store's own appointment options. Fitting system not named.

name: Trek Bicycle Göttingen
summary: Trek-operated store in Göttingen selling Trek road, gravel, MTB and city bikes plus Diamant. Listed as a Trek Project One retailer in the Trek store finder.

sources.name: Trek store finder – Project One retailers

name: Trek Bicycle Hameln
summary: Trek-operated store in Hameln selling Trek bikes plus Diamant. Listed as a Trek Project One retailer in the Trek store finder.

sources.name: Trek store finder – Project One retailers

name: Rad Spezi Mesmer Wolfsburg
summary: Wolfsburg branch of the Rad Spezi Mesmer e-bike and bike shops (also Braunschweig and Vechelde). Listed as a Trek Project One retailer in the Trek store finder; Trek is among the brands on the shop's site.
uncertain: The shop's own pages did not show the Wolfsburg street address (the Trek finder gives Schulzen Hof 12, 38442 Wolfsburg). Range is mainly e-bikes; road-bike focus unclear.

sources.name: Trek store finder – Project One retailers

name: Hornburg Bikes
summary: Bike, e-bike and cargo-bike shop with stores in Sehnde (Region Hannover) and Hildesheim, run by Hornburg Automobile GmbH. The Sehnde store is listed as a Trek Project One retailer in the Trek store finder.
uncertain: The shop's own pages did not name Trek or Project One in the text checked; the claim rests on the Trek store finder. Second store: Kennedydamm 33, 31141 Hildesheim (Impressum address).

sources.name: Trek store finder – Project One retailers

name: Zweirad Jung Northeim
summary: Northeim branch of Zweirad Jung GmbH (headquartered in Köln), a large bike and e-bike retailer. Santa Cruz is one of the brand worlds on the company's site.
uncertain: Santa Cruz is shown company-wide; whether the Northeim store stocks Santa Cruz bikes is not stated. Mainly e-bike and everyday range.

name: Rademacher Bicycles
summary: Bike shop in Schwerin's Schelfstadt, open since 1988, listed by Colnago, Cervélo and Pinarello as a dealer. It offers bike fitting with Smartfit analysis tools and builds custom bikes from frame upwards, alongside a wide range of e-bikes, touring and city bikes.
uncertain: Look, Santa Cruz and Trek are named on the shop's brand page but were not checked against those brands' locators.

name: Fahrrad-Station
summary: Large bike shop in Flensburg with a separate outlet, listed as a Pinarello, Cervélo, Ridley and Trek Project One dealer. Wilier also appears among its partner brands.
uncertain: Wilier dealership is based only on the shop's brand logos.

sources.name: Trek store finder (Project One retailer filter)
Trek store page – Fahrrad Station Arnold

name: Jonito Bikes
summary: Online bike retailer with a showroom and workshop in Lübeck, listed as a Pinarello, Ridley and Trek Project One dealer. Bikes ordered online are assembled in its own workshop.

sources.name: Trek store finder (Project One retailer filter)

name: Laufrad Lübeck
summary: Bike shop and master workshop in Lübeck's old town with a second branch at Im Gleisdreieck 12. Both locations are listed as Trek Project One retailers.

sources.name: Trek store finder (Project One retailer filter)

name: at Fahrräder
summary: Small road, gravel and touring bike shop with workshop in Lübeck's Beckergrube. It lists Colnago, Basso and Tommasini among its brands and builds up bikes in individual configurations.
uncertain: Colnago dealership is shown on the shop's website only; the shop does not appear in Colnago's store locator.

name: Fahrradhandlung Willert 2.0
summary: Bike shop in Groß Grönau, just south of Lübeck, listed in Colnago's store locator.
uncertain: The shop's website blocked our requests, so street address, range and services could not be verified on its own pages.

name: Ihr Fahrradprofi
summary: Bike shop in business since 1994 with a 2,000 m² store in Ahrensbök, between Lübeck and the Holstein lakes. Specialized lists it as an S-Works store.

name: Ihr Fahrradprofi Bad Segeberg
summary: Bad Segeberg branch of Ihr Fahrradprofi, listed by Specialized as an S-Works store.

name: GEFU Zweiräder
summary: Bike shop in Henstedt-Ulzburg, north of Hamburg, listed as a Trek Project One retailer.

sources.name: Trek store finder (Project One retailer filter)

name: radhaus Rostock
summary: Bike shop near Rostock's Kröpeliner-Tor-Vorstadt with a workshop of up to five mechanics, listed as a Trek Project One retailer. It also lists custom bikes and individual saddle-position adjustment among its services.
uncertain: No details published on the custom-bike or position-adjustment services.

sources.name: Trek store finder (Project One retailer filter)

name: Rad Shop Tietz
summary: Large bike shop in Neubrandenburg with more than 800 bikes in stock, listed in Cervélo's store locator. Its road range includes Cervélo and Basso.

name: Specialized Store Schwerin (Fahrrad Rachow)
summary: Specialized brand store in Schwerin run by the regional retailer Fahrrad Rachow, listed by Specialized as an S-Works store, with workshop and test rides.

name: Fahrrad Rachow
summary: Main store of the Mecklenburg retailer Fahrrad Rachow in Gägelow, just west of Wismar, listed by Specialized as an S-Works store. The company has further branches in Schwerin and Wittenburg.
uncertain: Street address taken from the site footer and contact page; the formal Impressum page did not load.
